#load data

## load 5mc data -CELL-LINE

```{r}
lr_cell_line <- paste0("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/",cell_line,"/Me/", cell_line, "_pileup_m.bed.gz")%>%
  map_dfr(~fread(.x, select = c(1,2,3,4,5,11,12, 14), col.names = c("chrom", "star", "end", "mod_type", "Nvalid_cov","fraction_mod", "Nmod", "Nother_mod"), showProgress = T)%>%
             mutate(Sample = gsub("_pileup_m.bed.gz", "", basename(.x))))


```

## load 5mc data -PDX

```{r}
lr_pdx<- paste0("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/Me_all/",PDX, "_pileup_5mc_all.bed.gz")%>%
```

# QC plot

## sequencing quality

```{r}
library(ggridges)

qscore <- Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/*/QC/*_summary.tsv") %>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(.x, select = c("mean_qscore_template", "alignment_genome")) %>%
            filter(alignment_genome %in% paste0("chr", seq(1,22)))%>%
            mutate(sample = gsub("_summary.tsv", "", basename(.x)))) 

coverage <- Sys.glob("output/*/coverage/*mosdepth.summary.txt")%>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(.x)%>%
            mutate(sample = gsub("_unphased.mosdepth.summary.txt", "", basename(.x)),
                   sample = gsub("\\.mosdepth.summary.txt", "", sample))) %>%
  mutate(chrom = factor(chrom, level = paste0("chr", seq(1,22)))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(chrom))

nanopore_len <- Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/*/QC/*_summary.tsv") %>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(.x, select = c("sequence_length_template", "alignment_genome")) %>%
            filter(alignment_genome %in% paste0("chr", seq(1,22)))%>%
            mutate(sample = gsub("_summary.tsv", "", basename(.x)))) 


nanopore_len  %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(med = median(sequence_length_template))

coverage%>%
  group_by(sample, chrom) %>%
  summarise(coverage = round(sum(mean *bases / sum(bases)), 0)) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(med = median(coverage))

qscore  %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(med = median(mean_qscore_template))

len_plot <- nanopore_len %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  sample_n(n()/100) %>%
  mutate(sample_type = if_else( sample %in% cell_line, "Cell-line", "PDX")) %>%
  left_join(sample_name_mapping) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sequence_length_template , y= alt_name, fill = sample_type))+
  stat_density_ridges(quantile_lines = TRUE, quantiles = 2)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
       strip.text = element_blank())+
  facet_wrap(~sample_type, scale = "free_y", strip.position = "right", nrow = 2)+
  scale_x_continuous(transform = "log10", name = "Read Length (bp)")+
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = sample_type_palette, "Model type")

qscore_plot <- qscore %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  sample_n(n()/100) %>%
  mutate(sample_type = if_else( sample %in% cell_line, "Cell-line", "PDX")) %>%
  left_join(sample_name_mapping) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = mean_qscore_template, x= alt_name, fill = sample_type))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_bw()+
  facet_wrap(~sample_type, scale = "free_x", strip.position = "bottom")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
       strip.text.x = element_blank(),
       legend.position = "none")+
  ylab("Mean Base Quality Score")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = sample_type_palette)


coverage_plot <-coverage %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(coverage = round(sum(mean *bases / sum(bases)), 0)) %>%
  ungroup()  %>%
  mutate(sample_type = if_else( sample %in% cell_line, "Cell-line", "PDX")) %>%
  left_join(sample_name_mapping) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = alt_name, y = coverage, fill = sample_type))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black")+
  facet_wrap(~sample_type, scale = "free_x", strip.position = "top")+
  theme_bw()+
  geom_text(aes(label=paste0(coverage, "x")), vjust=0)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
       strip.text.x = element_blank(),
       axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
       legend.position = "none",
       axis.text.y = element_blank())+
  ylab("Averaged Depth")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = sample_type_palette, "Sample")


merged_plot <- ggarrange(len_plot,ggarrange(coverage_plot, qscore_plot, ncol = 2, align= "v", labels = c("B)", "C)")),  nrow =2 , common.legend = T, legend = "bottom", labels = c("A)", ""))
ggsave(plot = merged_plot, filename = "plots/nanopore_cell_line_qc.pdf",  width = 260, height = 297, units = "mm")

```

## Methylation correlation

```{r}
# correlation to methylation array
methylation_array <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/GSK_treated_OvCa/output/batch2_beta_post_filt.tsv") %>%
  dplyr::select(CpG, OVCAR8_LP_A6_30 = OVCAR8.A6.meth_DMSO, WEHI_CS62 = `62_DMSO2`) %>%
  left_join(fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/GSK_treated_OvCa/output/batch1_beta_post_filt.tsv") %>%
              dplyr::select(CpG, OVCAR8= OVCAR8_DMSO))
array_annotation <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/GSK_treated_OvCa/supporting/EPIC-8v2-0_A1.csv", header =T, skip ="IlmnID")

methylation_array <- methylation_array %>%
  left_join(array_annotation%>%
              dplyr::select(CpG = IlmnID,CHR, MAPINFO )) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("OVCAR8", "OVCAR8_LP_A6_30", "WEHI_CS62"), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "beta" )

lr_epiv2 <- methylation_array %>%
  left_join(lr_cell_line %>%
              filter(mod_type == "m") %>%
              mutate(m_h = (Nother_mod+Nmod)/Nvalid_cov) %>%
              dplyr::select(CHR = chrom, MAPINFO = end, fraction_mod,m_h, Sample))


lr_epiv2 %>%
  left_join(sample_name_mapping %>%
              dplyr::select(Sample =sample, alt_name)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = beta, y = m_h))+
  geom_bin2d()+
  stat_cor(label.y = 1.1) +
  stat_regline_equation(label.y = 1.05)+
  scale_fill_viridis_c( trans = "log2", name = "density")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5))+
  xlab("5mC + 5hmC per CpG (%)")+
  ylab("beta value (EPIC V2)")+
  facet_wrap(~alt_name)
ggsave("plots/array_lr_corr.pdf", units = "mm", width = 210*1.5, height = 297/3*1.5 )
```

##BRCA1 methylation status

```{r}
BRCA1_meth <- Sys.glob("Me_all/*pileup_5mc_brca1.tsv") %>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(.x) %>%
            mutate(Sample = gsub("_pileup_5mc_brca1.tsv", "", basename(.x))))%>%
  mutate(Meth = if_else(mod_qual >0.5, "Me", "Un"),
         meBRCA1 = case_when(Sample %in% hom_me_list ~"Hom meBRCA1",
                         Sample %in% het_me_list ~"Het meBRCA1",
                         Sample %in% c("UWB1", "UWB1_BRCA1") ~"No meBRCA1"),
         meBRCA1 = factor(meBRCA1, levels = c("Hom meBRCA1",  "Het meBRCA1", "No meBRCA1"))) %>%
  dplyr::filter( base_qual >=20) %>%
    dplyr::filter(ref_position <=43125457, ref_position >= 43125336, !inferred, mod_code == "m") 


pileup_BRCA1_meth <- Sys.glob("output/Me_all/*_pileup_islpro.bed.gz") %>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(.x, select = c(1,2,3,4,5,11,12, 14), col.names = c("chrom", "start", "end", "mod_type", "Nvalid_cov","fraction_mod", "Nmod", "Nother_mod")) %>%
            filter(start >= 43125336, end <= 43125457, chrom == "chr17", mod_type =="m") %>%
            mutate(Sample = gsub("_pileup_islpro.bed.gz", "", basename(.x)))) %>%
  mutate(meBRCA1 = case_when(Sample %in% hom_me_list ~"Hom meBRCA1",
                         Sample %in% het_me_list ~"Het meBRCA1",
                         Sample %in% c("UWB1", "UWB1_BRCA1") ~"No meBRCA1"),
         meBRCA1 = factor(meBRCA1, levels = c("Hom meBRCA1",  "Het meBRCA1", "No meBRCA1"))) 


pileup_BRCA1_meth %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = start, group = Sample, color = meBRCA1, y = fraction_mod))+
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6)+
  geom_point(size = 4)+
  scale_color_manual(values = sample_palette)+
  theme_bw()+
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",strip.background = element_rect(fill  = NA))+
  scale_y_continuous(name = "5mC (%)")+
  xlab("Chromosomal Position (hg38)")

ggsave("plots/Methylation_promoter.pdf", height = 6.5, width = 12)

BRCA1_meth <- BRCA1_meth %>%
  mutate(ref_position = if_else(ref_strand == "-", ref_position -1, ref_position)) %>%
  group_by(Sample, ref_position) %>%
  filter(n()>2) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  group_by(Sample, ref_position) %>%
  filter(n()>2) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  group_by(Sample, read_id) %>%
  filter(n()>2) %>%
  mutate(perc_meth = sum(Meth == "Me") / n()) %>%
  ungroup()

read_order = BRCA1_meth %>%
  dplyr::select(read_id, perc_meth) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(perc_meth)

plot_list <- BRCA1_meth %>%
  mutate(read_id = factor(read_id, levels = read_order$read_id)) %>%
  left_join(sample_name_mapping %>%
              dplyr::select(Sample=sample, alt_name)) %>%
  group_by(meBRCA1, alt_name) %>%
  group_map(~ 
  ggplot(.x, aes(x =ref_position, y = read_id, color = Meth))+
  geom_point()+
  facet_wrap(~alt_name, nrow = 8, dir = "v", scales = "free_y")+
  theme_bw()+
    scale_colour_manual(values = methylation_palette)+
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(colour=sample_palette2[unique(.x$meBRCA1)], face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), 
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()), .keep = T)

layout <-"
AF
BG
CH
EI
DJ
MK
NL
"

plot_list[[1]]+plot_list[[2]]+plot_list[[3]]+plot_list[[4]]+
  plot_list[[5]]+plot_list[[6]]+plot_list[[7]]+plot_list[[8]]+
  plot_list[[9]]+ plot_list[[10]]+ plot_list[[11]]+plot_list[[12]]+
  plot_list[[13]]+plot_list[[14]]+
  plot_layout(design = layout, guides = "collect")&
  theme(legend.position='bottom')

ggsave("plots/reads_resolution.pdf",  height = 297*1.5, width =180*1.5 , units = "mm" )
```

```{r}
hrdetect_all <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/hrdetect.tsv") %>%

         meBRCA1= case_when(sample %in% het_me_list ~ "Het meBRCA1",

                            sample %in% c("UWB1", "OVCAR8_LP_H4_53") ~ "Mut BRCA1",
                            TRUE~ "WT BRCA1"),
        alt_name = factor(alt_name, levels= c( "WEHI CS62", "OVCAR8 LP A6-meth", "OVCAR8","NSCLC", "SCLC",  "OVCAR8 LP H4-KO", "UWB1", "UWB1+BRCA1", "134011",  "134062", "SFRC01585", "134169","134048", "SFRC01428", "SFRC01495",  "SFRC01865", "SFRC01951")))

        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right")

  dplyr::rename(sample = Sample) %>%

  mutate(alt_name = case_when(sample == "3300152" ~"SCLC",
                              sample == "3300199" ~"NSCLC",
                              TRUE ~as.character(alt_name)),
         sample_type = case_when(sample %in% c("OVCAR8", "UWB1", "UWB1_BRCA1", "WEHI_CS62", "OVCAR8_LP_A6_30", "OVCAR8_LP_H4_53") ~"HR Scar Control",
                                 sample %in% c("3300152", "3300199") ~"HRP Control",
                                 TRUE ~ "PDX"),
         meBRCA1= case_when(sample %in% het_me_list ~ "Het meBRCA1",
                            sample %in% hom_me_list ~ "Hom meBRCA1",
                            sample %in% c("UWB1", "OVCAR8_LP_H4_53") ~ "mut BRCA1",
                            TRUE~ "wt BRCA1"),
        alt_name = factor(alt_name, levels= c( "WEHI CS62", "OVCAR8 LP A6-meth", "OVCAR8","NSCLC", "SCLC",  "OVCAR8 LP H4-KO", "UWB1", "UWB1+BRCA1", "134011",  "134062", "SFRC01585", "134169","134048", "SFRC01428", "SFRC01495",  "SFRC01865", "SFRC01951"))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(alt_name))%>% 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace_na(., 0))) %>%

  left_join(sig_list_cosmicv2_palette) %>%
  mutate(Sig_annot = factor(Sig_annot, levels = sig_list_cosmicv2_palette$Sig_annot)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = alt_name, y= proportion, fill = Sig_annot))+
   geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack")+
  facet_wrap(~sample_type, scales = "free_x")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(as.character(sig_list_cosmicv2_palette$colour), sig_list_cosmicv2_palette$Sig_annot), "COSMIC SBS v2")+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1), "Proportion Signature")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right")
```

#Reads spiltting 
```{r}
library(Rsamtools)
source("scripts/meth_sv/sv_extract_support.R")
param <- ScanBamParam(which=GRanges("chr17", IRanges(43044295- 5000, 43125364 + 5000)),
  what = c("qname", "flag", "rname", "pos", "mapq", "cigar", 
           "seq", "qual"),
  flag = scanBamFlag(isSupplementary = NA))
bam_data <- scanBam("output/SFRC01585S1_2163_T3/SFRC01585S1_2163_T3_mapped_sc.bam", param=param)

bam_df <- do.call(data.frame, bam_data[[1]])
bam_df%>%
  pull(qname) %>%
  unique(.) %>%
  write.table(., file = "output/SFRC01585S1_2163_T3/BRCA1_mapped_readid.txt", row.names = F, quote = F)


param <- ScanBamParam(what = c("qname", "flag", "rname", "pos", "mapq", "cigar", 
           "seq"),
  flag = scanBamFlag(isSupplementary = NA))

bam_data <- scanBam("output/SFRC01585S1_2163_T3/BRCA1_supp.bam", param=param)
bam_df <- do.call(data.frame, bam_data[[1]])

bam_df <- bam_df%>%
  filter(! str_detect(rname , "_" )) 

sec_mapped <- bam_df %>%
  group_by(qname) %>%
  filter(n()>1) %>%
  arrange(qname)

pri_mapped <- bam_df %>%
  group_by(qname) %>%
  filter(n()==1) %>%
  arrange(qname)


sec_mapped<- sec_mapped %>%
  mutate(strand = if_else(flag %in% c(272, 16, 2064), "-", "+")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(spam = process_cigar_positions(strand, pos, cigar)) %>%
  separate(sep = " ", into = c("ref_start", "ref_end", "read_start", "read_end"), col = "spam") %>%
  mutate(ref_start =as.numeric(ref_start), 
         ref_end = as.numeric(ref_end))

read_order <- sec_mapped %>%
  filter(rname == "chr17", pos >= 43044295- 5000, pos <=43125364 + 5000) %>%
  group_by(qname) %>%
  summarise(smallest_pos = min(pos)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(smallest_pos)


alt_map <- sec_mapped %>%
  filter(rname != "chr17") %>%
  group_by(qname) %>%
  summarise(alt_map = paste0(rname, ":",ref_start,  "-", ref_end)) %>%
  summarise(alt_map = paste(unique(alt_map), collapse = ";")) %>%
  left_join(sec_mapped  %>% filter(rname == "chr17") %>%
              dplyr::select(ref_start, qname))
  

sec_mapped %>%
  mutate(qname = factor(qname, levels = read_order$qname)) %>%
  ggplot()+
  geom_segment(data = . %>% filter(rname == "chr17", , pos >= 43044295- 5000, pos <=43125364 + 5000) ,aes(x = ref_start, xend = ref_end, yend = qname, y =qname))+
  geom_text(data = alt_map, aes(y = qname, x = ref_start, label = alt_map), size = 3)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))


```

# Global analysis

##HRD vs HRP\

### global methylation diff

```{r}
global_filtered <- lr_cell_line %>%
  filter(mod_type == 'm', Nvalid_cov >= 10,Nvalid_cov <= 100, chrom %in% paste0("chr", seq(1,22))) %>%
  mutate(site = paste(chrom, start, end , sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(site, fraction_mod, Sample) %>%
  dt_pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = fraction_mod) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  dt_pivot_longer(cols = c(OVCAR8, OVCAR8_LP_A6_30, UWB1, UWB1_BRCA1, WEHI_CS62), values_to = "fraction_mod", names_to = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(HR = if_else(Sample %in% c("OVCAR8", "UWB1_BRCA1"), "HRP", "HRD"))


global_filtered$HR <- ordered(global_filtered$HR, levels = c("HRP", "HRD"))


global_filtered %>%
  group_by(Sample)%>%
  mutate(Sample = if_else(Sample == "OVCAR8_LP_A6_30", "OVCAR8_A6_meth", Sample),
          Sample =  factor(Sample, levels = c("OVCAR8_A6_meth", "OVCAR8", "UWB1", "UWB1_BRCA1", "WEHI_CS62"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Sample, y = fraction_mod, color = HR))+
  geom_violin()+
  stat_summary(fun = "median",
               geom = "crossbar", 
               color = "black",
               width = 0.1)+
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("OVCAR8_A6_meth","OVCAR8"), c("UWB1", "UWB1_BRCA1")),method = "wilcox")+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("HRD" = "#196B24", "HRP"= "#E97132"))+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave("plots/cell_line_global_comparison.pdf", height =5, width = 7)
```

```{r}
global_filtered <- lr_cell_line_5hmc %>%
  filter(Nvalid_cov >= 10,Nvalid_cov <= 100, chrom %in% paste0("chr", seq(1,22))) %>%
  mutate(site = paste(chrom, start, end , sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(site, fraction_mod, Sample) %>%
  dt_pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = fraction_mod) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  dt_pivot_longer(cols = c(OVCAR8, OVCAR8_LP_A6_30, UWB1, UWB1_BRCA1, WEHI_CS62), values_to = "fraction_mod", names_to = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(HR = if_else(Sample %in% c("OVCAR8", "UWB1_BRCA1"), "HRP", "HRD"))


global_filtered$HR <- ordered(global_filtered$HR, levels = c("HRP", "HRD"))


global_filtered %>%
  group_by(Sample)%>%
  mutate(Sample = if_else(Sample == "OVCAR8_LP_A6_30", "OVCAR8_A6_meth", Sample),
          Sample =  factor(Sample, levels = c("OVCAR8_A6_meth", "OVCAR8", "UWB1", "UWB1_BRCA1", "WEHI_CS62"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Sample, y = fraction_mod, color = HR))+
  geom_violin()+
  stat_summary(fun = "median",
               geom = "crossbar", 
               color = "black",
               width = 0.1)+
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("OVCAR8_A6_meth","OVCAR8"), c("UWB1", "UWB1_BRCA1")),method = "wilcox")+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("HRD" = "#196B24", "HRP"= "#E97132"))+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave("plots/cell_line_global_comparison.pdf", height =5, width = 7)
```

# load SV for bp

```{r}
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
sv <- fread("output/OVCAR8/SV/OVCAR8.nanomonsv.result.vcf", skip = "#CHROM") %>%
  filter(FILTER== "PASS",
         `#CHROM` %in% paste0("chr", seq(1,22))) %>%
  separate(TUMOR, into = c("TR", "VR"), sep = ":") %>%
  filter(as.numeric(TR)/as.numeric(VR) >0.25)  %>%
  mutate(sv_type = str_extract(INFO, "(?<=SVTYPE=)[^;]+"),
         SV_end = as.numeric(str_extract(INFO, "(?<=END=)[^;]+")),
         SV_len = as.numeric(str_extract(INFO, "(?<=SVLEN=)[^;]*")),
         SV_inslen = as.numeric(str_extract(INFO, "(?<=SVINSLEN=)[^;]*"))) %>%
  mutate(SV_len = if_else(is.na(SV_len), SV_inslen, SV_len)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-SV_inslen) %>%
  dplyr::rename(SV_start = POS)
  

sv %>%
  mutate(SV_end = if_else(is.na(SV_end), SV_start, SV_end)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(end = max(SV_start, SV_end), start = min(SV_start, SV_end)) %>%
  makeGRangesFromDataFrame(., seqnames.field = "#CHROM", start.field = "start", end.field = "end") %>%
  export.bed(.,con='OVCAR8_nanomonsv_bp.bed')


```

```{r}
sv_extracted_mod <- fread("output/OVCAR8/OVCAR8_nanomonsv_bp_extracted_mod.tsv") %>%
  filter(mod_code =="m")

read_id_sv_mapping  <- sv_extracted_mod  %>%
  filter(ref_position != -1) %>%
  mutate(pos = if_else(ref_strand== "+",
                       ref_position - forward_read_position+ fw_soft_clipped_start+1,
                       ref_position - read_length + forward_read_position)) %>%
  group_by(read_id)%>%
  summarise(chr = unique(chrom),read_start  =min(pos), read_end = max(pos)) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
      left_join(sv %>%
                  filter(as.numeric(TR) <=70, as.numeric(VR) /as.numeric(TR) >0.2) %>%
    dplyr::select(chr = `#CHROM`, SV_start, SV_end, sv_type, TR, VR, SV_len) , join_by(chr == chr, read_start <= SV_end , read_end >= SV_start )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sv_type)) %>%
  group_by(read_id) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(SV_start) ==1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(SV_start, SV_end) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(read_id)>=VR) %>%
  ungroup()
  


read_id_sv_mapping %>%
  left_join(sv_extracted_mod %>%
              dplyr::select(read_id, chr = chrom, ref_position,forward_read_position, mod_qual),by = c("chr", "read_id")) %>%
  mutate(forward_read_position_bp = SV_start - read_start)

```

```{r}


# one event per read for simplicity
read_id_sv_mapping <- read_id_sv_mapping %>%
  group_by(read_id, read_start, read_end ) %>%
  filter(n()==1) %>%
  ungroup()


#insertion
insertion <- read_id_sv_mapping %>%
  filter(sv_type == "INS") %>%
  left_join(sv_extracted_mod %>%
              dplyr::select(read_id, chr = chrom, ref_position,forward_read_position, mod_qual),by = c("chr", "read_id"))%>%
  mutate(type = if_else(ref_position== -1 & forward_read_position >= SV_start - read_start & forward_read_position-5 <=SV_start -read_start+SV_len+5, "INS", "MAPPED"),
         relative_pos = (forward_read_position - (SV_start- read_start)))  %>%
  group_by(read_id) %>%
  mutate(read_type = if_else(sum(type == "INS")>0, "ALT", "REF"))

insertion %>%
  filter(ref_position != -1) %>%
  mutate(relative_pos = ref_position - SV_start) %>%
  group_by(SV_start, SV_end, read_type, relative_pos) %>%
  summarise(mod = mean(mod_qual)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes( x = relative_pos, y = mod))+
   geom_bin2d()+
  facet_wrap(~read_type, scales = "free")+
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Spectral", trans = "log2")

merged_diff <- insertion %>%
  filter(ref_position != -1) %>%
  mutate(relative_pos = ref_position - SV_start) %>%
  group_by(SV_start, SV_end, read_type, relative_pos) %>%
  summarise(mod = mean(mod_qual)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(SV_start, SV_end,relative_pos) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(read_type) ==2) %>%
  ungroup() 

merged_diff%>%
  dt_pivot_wider(names_from = read_type, values_from = mod) %>%
  mutate(diff =ALT -REF) %>%
  filter(abs(relative_pos)<500) %>%
  ggplot(aes( x = relative_pos, y = diff))+
   geom_bin2d()+
  theme_bw()+
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Spectral", trans = "log2")

insertion %>%
  filter(ref_position == -1, type == "INS") %>%
  filter(relative_pos <= SV_len) %>%
  group_by(SV_start, SV_end, relative_pos) %>%
  summarise(mod = mean(mod_qual)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes( x = relative_pos, y = mod))+
   geom_bin2d()+
  theme_bw()+
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Spectral", trans = "log2")

insertion %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(SV_len) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(-SV_len)

adj_ins <- insertion%>%
  group_by(read_id) %>%
  mutate(
    next_ref_position = lead(ref_position), 
    prior_ref_position = lag(ref_position),
    unmapped_flag = lead(type)  == "INS"
  ) %>%
  mutate(prior_row_filter = lag(next_ref_position )== -1 & lag(prior_ref_position) != -1 & lag(unmapped_flag) &lag(type) == "MAPPED") %>%
  filter((next_ref_position == -1 & prior_ref_position != -1 & unmapped_flag & type == "MAPPED") | prior_row_filter) %>%
    group_by(read_id) %>%
  filter(n()==2) %>%
  ungroup()  

adj_ins %>%
  dplyr::select(read_id,type, mod_qual) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = mod_qual) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = MAPPED, y = INS))+
  geom_bin2d()+
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Spectral", trans = "log2")+
  theme_bw()


adj_ins  %>%
  dplyr::select(read_id,type, mod_qual, forward_read_position) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = c(mod_qual, forward_read_position)) %>%
  mutate(diff_mod = mod_qual_INS - mod_qual_MAPPED,  diff_dist = forward_read_position_INS - forward_read_position_MAPPED) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = diff_dist, y = diff_mod))+
  geom_point()


adj_ins  %>%
  group_by(SV_start, SV_end, ref_position) %>%
  filter(n()>1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(SV_start, SV_end) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(ref_position)>1)
```

```{r}
  map_dfr(~fread(.x, skip = "#CHROM", col.names = c("chr", "pos", "id","ref", "alt", "qual", "filter", "info", "format", "details")) %>%

  left_join(delly_cn, by = join_by("SampleID"=="SampleID", "chr" == "chr", "start" >= "cn_start", "start" <= "cn_end"))%>%
  mutate(cn = if_else(is.na(cn), 2, cn),
    adjme = round(me_percent *cn /100),
         fullme = adjme==cn,
         fullunme = adjme ==0) %>%
  mutate(group = if_else(SampleID %in% c(hom_me_list, "OVCAR8_LP_H4_53", "UWB1"), "hom", "het"))

perform_fisher_test <- function(group1_methylated, group1_unmethylated, group2_methylated, group2_unmethylated) {
  table_methylated <- matrix(c(group1_methylated, group2_methylated,
                               group1_unmethylated, group2_unmethylated),
                             nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
  fisher.test(table_methylated)$p.value
}
meth_cn = data.table(meth_cn)


summary_data <- meth_cn[, .(
  FullyMethylated_Group1 = sum(fullme[group == "hom"], na.rm = TRUE),
  FullyUnmethylated_Group1 = sum(fullunme[group == "hom"], na.rm = TRUE),
  FullyMethylated_Group2 = sum(fullme[group == "het"], na.rm = TRUE),
  FullyUnmethylated_Group2 = sum(fullunme[group == "het"], na.rm = TRUE),
  Total_Group1 = sum(group == "hom"),
  Total_Group2 = sum(group == "het")),
by = pos]

summary_data[, PValue_FullyMethylated := mapply(
  perform_fisher_test,
  FullyMethylated_Group1,
  Total_Group1 - FullyMethylated_Group1,
  FullyMethylated_Group2,
  Total_Group2 - FullyMethylated_Group2
)]

summary_data[, PValue_FullyUnmethylated := mapply(
  perform_fisher_test,
  FullyUnmethylated_Group1,
  Total_Group1 - FullyUnmethylated_Group1,
  FullyUnmethylated_Group2,
  Total_Group2 - FullyUnmethylated_Group2
)]

summary_data[, FDR_FullyMethylated := p.adjust(PValue_FullyMethylated, method = "fdr")]
summary_data[, FDR_FullyUnmethylated := p.adjust(PValue_FullyUnmethylated, method = "fdr")]

# Filter significant CpG sites
significant_cpgs <- summary_data[FDR_FullyMethylated < 0.06 | FDR_FullyUnmethylated < 0.06]


saveRDS(summary_data, file = "/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/summary_data_hrd_hrp.rds")

# Print significant CpG sites
```

#EdgeR

```{r}
library(edgeR)
hom_me_list <- list("134011", "134062", "SFRC01585", "WEHI_CS62", "OVCAR8_LP_A6_30")

mRNA <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/mRNA/Kondrashova_-_HRD_-_RNAseq_Feb_2025.genes.ExpectedCounts.csv") 

gene_list <- mRNA %>%
  dplyr::select( -starts_with("134"), -starts_with("S"), -starts_with("O")) %>%
  mutate(Length = `Gene End (bp)` - `Gene Start (bp)`) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Ensembl Gene ID")
mRNA_cnts <- mRNA%>%
  dplyr::select(gene_ID = `Ensembl Gene ID`, starts_with("134")|starts_with("S")|starts_with("O"), -Strand)


mRNA_cnts <- mRNA_cnts %>%
    column_to_rownames(var = "gene_ID")

sample_list <- data.frame(sample = colnames(mRNA_cnts) ) %>%
  separate(sample, into = c("sample", "drop"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") %>%
  dplyr::select(-drop) %>%
  mutate(sample = gsub("S1|S2", "",sample), 
         BRCA1 = if_else(sample %in% hom_me_list, "Hom", "Het"))
  

star_matrix <- DGEList(counts = mRNA_cnts, group = factor(sample_list$BRCA1), samples = sample_list, genes = gene_list)

boxplot(cpm(star_matrix, log =T), use.cols = T)     

keep <- filterByExpr(star_matrix)
design.mat <- model.matrix(~star_matrix$samples$group)
star_matrix <- star_matrix[keep,, keep.lib.sizes=FALSE]
star_matrix <- calcNormFactors(star_matrix)
boxplot(cpm(star_matrix, log =T), use.cols = T)    

prior_count <- 2
lib_size <- star_matrix$samples$lib.size * star_matrix$samples$norm.factors
scaled_prior_count <- prior_count * lib_size / mean(lib_size)
adj_lib_size <- lib_size + 2 * scaled_prior_count

fpkm <- t((t(star_matrix$counts) + scaled_prior_count) / adj_lib_size) * 1e6 / star_matrix$genes$Length * 1e3
tpm <- t(t(fpkm) / colSums(fpkm)) * 1e6
log_tpm <- log2(tpm)

star_matrix <- estimateDisp(star_matrix, design.mat, robust= T)
norm_counts <- cpm(star_matrix, log=TRUE)



gene_list %>%
  filter(str_detect(`Associated Gene Name`, "BRCA1"))


data.frame(log_tpm[c("ENSG00000012048" ),]) %>%
  `colnames<-`(c("log_tpm")) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  separate(sample, into = c("sample", "drop"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") %>%
  dplyr::select(-drop) %>%
  mutate(sample = gsub("S1|S2", "", sample),
         sample = if_else(sample == "SOLACE20126", "SFRC01951", sample),
         meBRCA1 = if_else(sample %in% hom_me_list, "Hom meBRCA1", "Het meBRCA1")
         ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = log_tpm, x =meBRCA1, color = meBRCA1, label = sample))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_text_repel(nudge_x = 0.4,segment.color = 'grey50')+
  scale_colour_manual(values = sample_palette)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none")+
  ylab("BRCA1 Expression (log(TPM))")
ggsave("plots/PDX_BRCA1_mRNA.pdf", height = 4, width =5.5)
  
  

```
